SELECT 
  store_id,
  AVG(total_amount) AS avg_per_rental_total,
  AVG(payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental
FROM (
  SELECT 
    i.store_id,
    r.rental_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount,
    COUNT(p.payment_id) AS payment_count
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  WHERE p.amount >= 4.99
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
)
GROUP BY store_id
